content: Noma Paulus namkek tutga ina-ama mak ha rpol niana re pa nakot la re: “Ama-hyal miy re, nodia pa ler di, awuarora de ukleh hal la Uplerlawna la'a a mormio'ru-dardia'ru ralamni.”
Rnahmi rer lia lir de pede imam lawna, Ananias nhopna mak kaprir lia hande rkiria lo'mani (rpahara) la Paulus nurnu.

Noma Paulus nakot la imam lawna niwra: “Hota Uplerlawna Nwalo'ma o hgotmu, de (nurmu) yoma mputra-mpualka pa mtiot pa mhi' inonmu de riy plele'era. Mumtatan la hande pa muetlia a ha'lu, mliernohora Musa. Mere inon wamuehemu nek de muwlar dioinia Musa deullu-tatarni, pa mhuopna riy rwalo'ma a ga'yu.”
Riy mak ktutrier lia hande riwra: “Yana muhe'i-mumalia imam lawna la Uplerlawna.”
Paulus nakot la re: “Oh a'uplingoo! Ama-hyal miy re, a'uplinga de, riy de makla' imam lawna. Puklawna e nakota de: “Yana mihe'i-mimalia o'ta-mata hairi nayanni.””

Paulus nat niohora de la' mak kawok taru re, de riy Saduki, me riy Parisi erla pede Paulus nakot la mak kawok taru re: “Ama-hyal miy re, a' di de riy Parisi id a'u, me plola pa Parisi duratni-waitni a' di. Mimihak a plo'lu-a ha'lu la handi, yoma apuesiay hota mak kmati, hota rmori owa'ana.”
La'pa nakot emkade dewade Saduki rora Parisi idma nod lia'a-nod miai ida, pa nhi'nande woka-le' die nwal lia woka-le'u wor wua.
Yoma riy Saduki ralma-riorni de mak kmati re taken niana rmori owa'ana, me Uplerlawna hopopanni-li'irnu rora hmuakarnu (mati lianu) hadamonna. Mere riy Parisi rpesiay hare honona de erla.

La'pa kniokna-riarni na'ititar rer lia, Parisi riy wo'ira mak kla'a makwatutu-kwaye'a agama raprir pia rawahla lira re. Riwra: “La'a wniaror mamni de riy di edonna nhala kuku' eti. Yanhi'pa hmuakarnu onde Uplerlawna hopopanni-lili'irnu ror toto' e' pa raltieri.”

Yawenan lawan de pede makodi keki-rautu o'tani de namta'at pa yan kekwal die riy ru'uta-rtorna Paulus la letgara pa nhi'nande nmati. Pede e nhopan pa makodi keki-rautu re ra'ala Paulus la mutu letgarni pa rodia la ir yatiak genni (markasni).
La'pa lera nmel wa dewade Itmatromni Yesus Naprir lia Paulus onni me Nhar lirni niwra: “Mutehra ralammu. Emolmolla omukot nohora A'g olek la Yerusalem hota omlia mukot nohora wal lia letlawna Roma.”
Repar doini de riy Yahudi rawok pa rpanulga nnia'ohma-nniakatni. Ir rlokar rwah'a inonni, riwra hota ir edonna ra'ana-remnu la'pa lerni pa edonna rwenan ma'ta Paulus.
Ir wokni-le'enu de de riy o'ta terampwogat rehenu.

Rla'a imam-imam o'tani-matni, me Yahudi in letni-am letni pa rakot la: “Am miy re, a hononam di, amlokra-mhautu oleka inon mamni hota ami edonna ma'ana-memun ma'ta, la'pa nte'ela lerni pa ampenan Paulus de.

Ne dodo'ondi de miora mak ktorna agama watghudni re korni mlia' totpena mpiak la makodi keki-rautu o'tani mak kwatiawua Roma, mpiak la e'a, pa nodia Paulus pa nma ntut gaini owa'an la miy, emolmolla miy miwra mitian owa'ana plolli. Ne la'pa la talan letgara nanpena ampenna.”
Mere ira nnia'ohmani de Paulus narni a'nani muanke'a natlin nohora noma nla nakota Paulus la makodi keki-rautu yatiak genni.
Noma Paulus npolga makla' o'ta la makodi keki-rautu rahu ida, na'nama nakot la: “Tuna, mtiulan pa muodia tuwari di mlia'a miy o'tami de. Yoma e niwa nakot hadom la miy o'tami de.”
Noma nodia tuwari die la'a o'ta lawna pa nakot la: “Ama, Paulus mak ha rho'la tar die npol pua agodia tuwari di pa amuai a'mu la' handi. E niwa nakot hadom la a'mu.”
Noma o'ta lawan de ntorreria tuwari die limni pa nodia la wali pa natiana: “Omuiwra mukota hya' mai a'u?”

Noma tuwari die nwalolla: “Tuna, riy Yahudi re rna'ohma olekwa pa hota rwak la tuna totpa repar lerni de muodia Paulus la ina-ama mak ktorna agama watghudi re, totpena emolmolla iriwra ratiana plu'unu-plehenu owa'ana.

Yana mliernohora ir wakwakni de, yoma riy terampwogata rehenu e rwuw rer lia talan letgara pa hota rwenna la hande. Honona re rwalokr olekwa, pa hota edonna ra'ana-remnia hadoma la' ler maka edonna rwenan ma'ta Paulus. Ir honona e rwei tio' pa tuna nwayow nana ir wakwakni.”
Noma o'ta lawan de nakot la: “Ama, yan memmemna omukot hadella' riy ida, maka mukot oleka mai a'u la ler di.” Noma nhopan pa tuwari die nla'awa.
Ra'enyatga Paulus la Feliks
Nhorwua noma o'ta lawanni de npolga makodi keki-rautu o'tani woru pua nakot la: “Mpiahor doinia makodi keki-rautu riy rahu woru, rora mak kodia kuda ya'ara terampwo'itu, me makodia tera-ra'pa
riy rahu woru pa rarian pa rla'awa Kaisarea la jam wosiewa mela.
Mial walia kuda pa Paulus nha'at la me mitiak kalwieda pa miodia la Gubernur Feliks.”
Me Komandan nal walia horta id pa rodia. La horat de Komandana nakot emkadilla:
“Gubernur Feliks maka aghu'ru-aghelma (ahormata-kanala). Klaudius Lisias, awuak kalwieda tiy o'a.

content.text: Riy di, riy Yahudi rtorn oleka wa me tre' kuku' nekpa rwenna, mere a'uplet nohora a lidnu ne ulewna, yoma utlina de Paulus di riy Roma ida de.
La'pa agiwa gat wual lia' halli hya', pede agodi e' la Yahudi o'tani-matni mak ktorna agama watghudni.

Mere utlina de nakleha do'a-hala mak krei totpena rodia niukum matmiati onde rodia la roma nhio'la. Lir mak ha rodi re, de edonna tlernana la lodna-hairi niukamnu maka rdeul taru-rtatar taru. Mere rawo'or nohor neka Musa deullu-tatarni mak ir memeh'a nanpa rlernohora.

La' walia riy rma rakot mai a'u, de Yahudi re rna'ohma yatyatni la riy di. Hade pede aghopan pa rodia rmai wia tuna Gubernura. Ne aghopan wal pia mak kaklaka e'a re, ror wal pia, rmai totpena rakot nohora la'a hya'a rerieini pa e raklaka hadi totpena tuna nmeh'a natlin walia.”

content: Noka makodi keki-rautu re radil doin wa. Ra'ala Paulus la mel de meman pa rodi rla'awa leta Antipatris.
Repar noma kud ya'ara lidanni nodia Paulus pa rodi liarni. Ne korni re rawal lia makodi keki-rautu yatiak genni.
La'pa kud ya'ara re lidanni nte'ela Kaisarea noma rodia horta pa rala la Gubernur, ne ral walia Paulus la.
La'pa Gubernur de npaikia horat pa nhorwua, noma natiana Paulus: “Ee, ompuatiawu hya' noha (propinsi)?” “Tuna, awuatiawua Kilikia.” La'pa natga Paulus de nwatiawua Kilikia,
noma nakot la: “Emkadewa, hota a'g ed mak ketlia o lirmu-tunmu mere, twewiei niohora mak kaklak o'a re.” Noma nhopan pa ratiak reria Paulus la ray Herodes romni.
